# WiseTwin

> WiseTwin is a French consulting and services firm that develops digital solutions for
> industry. Founded by three partners with industrial backgrounds, it accelerates the
> digital transformation of industrial companies with tailor-made tools (training, HSE,
> 3D, data & AI) that are fast to deploy, affordable, and sized for a single site's
> budget. It also publishes its own products: the custom trainings WiseTrainer (3D
> simulators) and WiseTour (immersive safety inductions), billed once per project; the
> modular LMS platform with its WisePaper editor and Ask AI safety copilot (yearly
> subscription); and WiseAtlas (territorial communication, on quote).

WiseTwin's philosophy: operational excellence and industrial performance come from tools
designed by and for the teams who use them, without disrupting their daily work. Digital must be
accessible in price and in design time; answers should be fast, tailor-made, and sized on
real identified needs. Projects start small: a first focused deliverable builds trust,
then the tool grows over time. There is no rigid org chart: the team assembles on the fly
around each client's need, across three units (Consulting / Data & AI / 3D & immersive).
Over 40 solutions delivered in one year; a specification defined within 48 hours.

Primary language: French (site available at /fr and /en). Website: https://wisetwin.eu

## Services (custom development & consulting)

- Training & HSE: training digitization, safety inductions, risk hunts, VR training,
  HSE prevention plans
- 3D, immersive & video: virtual tours, 3D simulators, digital twins, layout and flow
  simulation, video and 3D production
- Data, AI & software: custom business applications, artificial intelligence, UI/UX,
  cloud engineering, production monitoring
- Consulting & organization: transformation diagnosis, operational excellence,
  industrial performance, change management

How it works: day 1, a free discussion (on site if possible); day 2, a specification
with clear scope and controlled costs (free quote, no commitment); the following weeks,
iterative development with a fast first deliverable; then deployment and ongoing
support. Deliverables belong to the client.

## Tools (born in the field)

Two logics: custom trainings are projects billed once (an investment, no recurring
cost); platforms are yearly subscriptions per site that clients run autonomously.

- WiseTrainer (€5,000 to €15,000 per project, depending on scope) — the client's own
  facilities recreated as immersive 3D training simulators. Billed once; the 3D asset
  belongs to the client. Standalone deliverable: Windows/Mac executable or web build
  for the client's intranet or own LMS; hosting on the WiseTwin LMS is optional, never
  required.
- WiseTour — immersive safety induction of the client's site, built on a 3D scan
  (Gaussian splatting). Two ways in: a client who already has a scan (.ply, .splat,
  .ksplat, .spz, .sog or .glb files) uploads it into the WiseTour editor, an LMS brick
  at €400/yr, and adds zones, instructions, points of interest and quizzes alone;
  otherwise WiseTwin scans the site (technicians on site, or smartphone footage
  processed by WiseTwin) and delivers the tour turnkey for €10,000 to €20,000 per
  project depending on the site, billed once, the scan belonging to the client.
- The LMS platform (from €600/year for the core alone; €3,600/year all included
  with every brick) — the modular LMS: hosting and delivery of trainings (built by
  WiseTwin or imported by the client), completion tracking, verifiable certifications,
  unlimited learners, training plans, automatic reminders, dashboards and analytics.
  Optional bricks: WisePaper (€600/yr, AI editor turning PDF, Word and PowerPoint
  documents into interactive trainings with quizzes), WiseTour editor (€400/yr,
  upload your own 3D scan as .ply, .splat, .ksplat, .spz, .sog or .glb, then add zones,
  points of interest and quizzes yourself), Ask AI with the incident
  database (€800/yr, safety copilot: photo-based risk hunts, prevention reports,
  accident history searchable in natural language), integrations: SSO, webhooks and
  API (€1,200/yr). Clients can take the LMS alone and import their own trainings.
- WiseAtlas (on quote) — interactive map editor for territories and industrial
  infrastructure, used self-service or delivered as a turnkey project. 3D models,
  virtual tours, up-to-date data, shareable in one link.

## The team

Three units; the team assembles on the fly around each project:

- Gauthier — Consulting unit: transformation diagnosis, industrial performance, change
  management
- Manoel — Data & AI unit: business applications, data pipelines, AI components, cloud
  infrastructure
- Mickaël — 3D & immersive unit: simulators, virtual tours, digital twins in real-time
  3D

## Company

- WiseTwin is a French company based in Dunkerque (EcosystèmeD, 60 route du Pertuis du
  Môle, 59140 Dunkerque), at the heart of one of France's leading industrial basins,
  serving industrial sites of all sizes (SMEs to large groups), local authorities and
  territorial players in France and Europe
- Contact: contact@wisetwin.eu, free quote, no commitment; a discussion slot can be
  booked directly on the site
- Security: MFA, enterprise SSO, audit logs, GDPR-compliant, data hosted in Europe,
  ISO 27001 best practices, xAPI/cmi5 exports to existing LMS
